title: 第八章 暗劲巅峰！
slug: 分手后觉醒逆天改命系统
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

心中暗骂，叶凡反应很快，一拳打向一个汉子面门！

献血横飞，那汉子哼都没哼就仰倒在地！

其他汉子眼睛一眯，手掌从腰间一拔，十几柄开锋砍刀出现！

叶凡脸色微变，他知道，敢用刀，这已不是普通混混！

“望气术！”

叶凡眼中划过青光，瞬间世界变慢。

抓住机会，叶凡身体一匐，来了个扫堂腿。

砰砰声传出，那围住他的五六个汉子都摔倒在地。

趁这时间，叶凡双腿迈出，向外就跑。

他知道，现在想别的没用，他得先离开这。

“哼，跑？想死你就跑！”

冷哼响起，叶凡脸色一变，脚步停住。

不远处出现一个光头汉子。

这汉子手里架着一张复合弓，瞄准了他！

叶凡想运转望气术，系统跳出。

“警告，宿主之前跳河救人，已消耗大量灵气，现有灵气，无法再次发动望气术！”

叶凡眼神一沉，干脆抬起双手，“有话好说，不知我哪里得罪你们了？”

“好说，好说你妈！”

砰！叶凡后脑挨了下！

“你他妈能打是吧！来啊，打啊，现在怎么不打了！”

怒吼传出，几个被扫倒的汉子围过来，猛踹叶凡。

叶凡抱头蜷缩，护住要害。

“行了！这是小区，要打换个地，先捆起来带走！”

光头喝了声，那几人停止，拿出尼龙绳捆住叶凡，送到车上。

车子很快发动，十几秒后，消失在金城小区。

同一时间，当车离开后，一个身穿运动服青年从暗处走出。

他拿出手机，拨通一个号码。

“师父，那年轻人被一批人抓走了。”

电话传出吕纯阳声音，“不管那批人是谁，救下他，我不想他出事。”

“是。”

人影应声，挂了电话。

下一刻，他就猛踏地面，如一道幽灵，追向面包车。

同时，面包车内，叶凡被几人按着肩膀，其中一汉子阴冷道，“小子，等到地方，我整死你！”

叶凡已冷静下来，对那汉子道，“谁让你们对付我的？”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Cursing secretly in his heart, Ye Fan reacted quickly and punched a man in the face!

The blood donation flew everywhere, and the man fell to the ground without even making a sound!

The other men narrowed their eyes, pulled out their palms from their waists, and a dozen open-edge machetes appeared!

Ye Fan's expression changed slightly. He knew that if he dared to use a knife, he was no longer an ordinary gangster!

"Qi-watching technique!"

Green light flashed across Ye Fan's eyes, and the world slowed down instantly.

Seizing the opportunity, Ye Fan lowered his body and performed a sweeping kick.

There was a banging sound, and the five or six men surrounding him fell to the ground.

Taking advantage of this time, Ye Fan stepped out with his legs and ran outside.

He knew that it was useless to think about anything else now, he had to get out of here first.

"Humph, run? If you miss, just run!"

There was a cold snort, Mark's expression changed, and he stopped.

A bald man appeared not far away.

This man had a compound bow in his hand and was aiming at him!

Ye Fan wanted to use the Qi Watching Technique, but the system jumped out.

"Warning, the host has consumed a lot of spiritual energy by jumping into the river to save people. The current spiritual energy cannot be used again to activate the qi-watching technique!"

Ye Fan's eyes darkened, and he simply raised his hands, "If you have something to say, I wonder where I have offended you?"

"It's easy to talk to your mother!"

Bang!Ye Fan was hit on the back of the head!

"You can fucking fight, right? Come on, fight, why don't you fight now!"

There was an angry roar, and several men who had been knocked down gathered around and kicked Ye Fan violently.

Ye Fan hugged his head and huddled up, protecting his vitals.

"Okay! This is a community. If you want to move to another place, tie them up and take them away first!"

The bald man shouted, and the people stopped, took out the nylon rope, tied Ye Fan up, and carried him to the car.

The car started quickly and disappeared from the Jincheng community more than ten seconds later.

At the same time, after the car left, a young man wearing sportswear walked out of the darkness.

He took out his cell phone and dialed a number.

"Master, that young man was captured by a group of people."

Lu Chunyang's voice came from the phone, "No matter who those people are, save him. I don't want anything to happen to him."

"Yes."

The figure responded and hung up the phone.

The next moment, he stomped on the ground, chasing after the van like a ghost.

At the same time, in the van, Ye Fan was pressed on the shoulders by several people. One of the men said coldly, "Boy, when we get there, I will beat you to death!"

Ye Fan had calmed down and said to the man, "Who asked you to deal with me?"
